content: Qe week pa'qu' qiye'ji' pa'i t'eku'miiji' pa' Intata qe qa' ni'fenij ene' jukhew pekhewe' t'ejuyets pa' Intata, hats'inha qu' ƚakha'ye' qu' nithayiki pe'qu' witqistitsi'ij pa' Intata, qa pe'qu' natlanhetiyifi iye pa' Intata inqa'metets qu' net'ejuyets pe' witwuƚ'ets.
Pakha' qiji' pa'i in jukhewƚe iye qa yoksi'wen ji'jek pakha' nite' witt'unhaxiju'ƚ pe' wekwek, ma' qa' ne'nq'eletij pekhewe' ham nikfe'lets qa pekhewe' yeqfeetsinƚi'iikii pa'qu' ƚikheyije'.

Qa in ta'ƚijupi' in yoksi'wen pa' nite' witt'unhaxiju'ƚ pe' wekwek qa ƚakha' iye qu' nilanjiifi ek pe'qu' inqa'metetse' pa' Intata qu' net'ejuyets pe' ƚewuƚ'ets, in ƚunyejeyek pekhewep in t'ejuyets pe' ƚewuƚ'etsƚe'ek.
Qa ham pa'qu' ƚakha' ye'ƚe qu' net'eku'mi' aka' witiwqiye'jji', qe pa' Intata yijat'ij in t'eku'm iniiji' qa jintesti'yij, in ƚunye'jek pa'aj pa' Aaron'ik'i.

Qa hik ƚunye'j iye ha' Cristo, nite' ta'ƚets qu' neniwqinhetƚe in qiji' pa'i, qe ta'ƚets yijat'ij in yiwqinhetji'. Pakha' yit'ijets pa'aj: —Akha' k'ayaasija, hane'ej hats haqsiijkii qu' enekfik'i.—(Sal 2:7)
Qa kakhap qa yit'ijek: —Akha' nite' yili'ij qu' a'pa'iyi'ij, in ƚunyejju'ek pa' ƚeqniyak pa' Melquisedec.—(Sal 110:4)

Ha' Cristo in mexe i'nipji' ha'ne sehe', iyinii pa' Intata qa iyinijets qu' ni'fen, qe ewi'ƚƚe in ƚeke' qu' nilithinik'ui pa' witwamhi'. Qa in iyin qa nekju' pe' ƚet'ilii in ip qa yit'unhetik'i in iyet in iyin. Qa pa' Intata qa yepi'ye' qe ha' Jesús wetf'iljetsin qa week yaqsiijkii pa'qu' nisu'un pa' Intata.
Yemjeetax in Ƚa'staxija pa' Dios, qa nikfe'lets pa'n ƚunye'j qu' jintek'en in ta'ƚets pe' wekwek qu' jintaats'e'ej.
Qa in hats week ƚe'wisik'uyi' hakha'an qe yaqsiijkii pe' yit'ijets pa' Intata, ma' qa ƚakha' qa ta'ƚets pa' witiƚa'x nite' yili'ij qu' net'ejuyets week pekhewe' qu' netk'enets.
Qa hik ta'ƚijupi' pa' Intata qa yeni' qu' qiye'ji' pa'i, in ƚunyejju'ek pa' ƚeqniyak pa' Melquisedec.
Qa in t'ejuyets ha'ne Melquisedec olots pe'qu' jintit'ij, qa jutsitaxƚe qu' jintefel qe ekheweli'ƚ jutsitax qu' enikfe'li'ƚik'i.

In hats ƚa'nape'eƚijets in ƚ'ek'eni'ƚets ke' ƚe'sits tefelhitii, qekha hats a'maestrole'taxi'ƚipji'. Qa menjiitƚe ƚ'ijatshenheti'yi'ƚij ke' nite' jutsitetstax t'ejuyets pa' Intata. Ma' qa hats hik ejunyejeyi'ƚ iye qu' etu'f ƚi'iƚ qa nite' ƚeke' qu' etuji'ƚ na'aj t'un.
Qe week pakha' qu' mexe netu'fƚe, nite' nikfe'lets pa' yatsathen qa pa' nite' yatsathen, qe mexente' qi.
Qa na'ajƚe witaq t'un qa t'ejuyetsek pekhewe' hats qits, pekhewe'en in wenijatshenij qa nikfe'lets qu' nejeƚik'ui pa' ƚe'wis qa pa' uƚ'ax.
